ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Canvas Cyclone) DLL side-loading via legit signed binaries from user-writable paths
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's signature initial-foothold technique: dropping a renamed, legitimately-signed AV/vendor executable (Symantec RasTls, McAfee mcoemcpy, Adobe AcroTranscoder, Avast wsc_proxy, etc.) into a user-writable directory so it sideloads a malicious sibling DLL (KerrDown / Cobalt Strike beacon). The signed-binary-in-wrong-place pair is OceanLotus tradecraft going back to the Cobalt Kitty campaigns.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.process_name IN ("RasTls.exe","AcroBroker.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","TmPfw.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","VPDN_LU.exe","Sylvania.exe","DeElevator64.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","avp.exe") AND NOT (Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Windows\\*") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32 (OceanLotus) — known-side-loaded signed binary running from user-writable path
let OceanLotusSideloads = dynamic(["RasTls.exe","AcroBroker.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","TmPfw.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","VPDN_LU.exe","Sylvania.exe","DeElevator64.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","avp.exe"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where FileName in~ (OceanLotusSideloads)
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files")
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)")
| where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| join kind=leftouter (
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(14d)
    | where FileName endswith ".dll"
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\AppData\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\Temp\")
    | project DeviceId, InitiatingProcessId, SideloadedDll = FileName, SideloadedDllPath = FolderPath, DllSHA256 = SHA256
) on DeviceId, $left.ProcessId == $right.InitiatingProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, SignedBin = FileName, SignedBinPath = FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SideloadedDll, SideloadedDllPath, DllSHA256, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32 side-load via ASIM ImProcessCreate
let OceanLotusSideloads = dynamic(["RasTls.exe","AcroBroker.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsshld.exe","TmPfw.exe","wsc_proxy.exe","VPDN_LU.exe","Sylvania.exe","DeElevator64.exe","GoogleUpdate.exe","avp.exe"]);
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend TargetBase = tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where TargetBase in~ (OceanLotusSideloads)
| where not(TargetProcessName startswith @"C:\Program Files")
| where not(TargetProcessName startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)")
| where not(TargetProcessName startswith @"C:\Windows\")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Side-Loaded Signed Binary From User-Writable Path
id: f3a7c1b2-9d2e-4a51-8b6f-1c8e2a9b7d0a
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32/OceanLotus dropping legitimately-signed vendor binaries (Symantec RasTls, McAfee, Adobe Acro*, Avast wsc_proxy) into user-writable folders so they side-load a malicious sibling DLL.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2024/01/01
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\RasTls.exe'
      - '\AcroBroker.exe'
      - '\AcroTranscoder.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\mcvsshld.exe'
      - '\TmPfw.exe'
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\VPDN_LU.exe'
      - '\Sylvania.exe'
      - '\DeElevator64.exe'
      - '\GoogleUpdate.exe'
      - '\avp.exe'
  filter_legit_paths:
    Image|startswith:
      - 'C:\Program Files\'
      - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\'
      - 'C:\Windows\'
  filter_machine_acct:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_image and not (filter_legit_paths or filter_machine_acct)
falsepositives:
  - Portable or repackaged copies of these vendor tools deployed via non-standard installers
level: high
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\RasTls.exe OR *\\rastls.exe OR *\\AcroBroker.exe OR *\\acrobroker.exe OR *\\AcroTranscoder.exe OR *\\acrotranscoder.exe OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\McOEmCpy.exe OR *\\mcvsshld.exe OR *\\McVSShld.exe OR *\\TmPfw.exe OR *\\tmpfw.exe OR *\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_PROXY.EXE OR *\\VPDN_LU.exe OR *\\vpdn_lu.exe OR *\\Sylvania.exe OR *\\sylvania.exe OR *\\DeElevator64.exe OR *\\GoogleUpdate.exe OR *\\googleupdate.exe OR *\\avp.exe) -@Image:(C\:\\Program?Files\\* OR C\:\\Program?Files?\(x86\)\\* OR C\:\\Windows\\*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(RasTls|AcroBroker|AcroTranscoder|mcoemcpy|mcvsshld|TmPfw|wsc_proxy|VPDN_LU|Sylvania|DeElevator64|GoogleUpdate|avp)\.exe$/i
| NOT (ImageFileName=/^[A-Z]:\\Program Files( \(x86\))?\\/i)

ucs.rationale: OceanLotus has been observed dropping these exact signed binaries (Symantec rastls, McAfee mcoemcpy/mcvsshld, Avast wsc_proxy, AcroTranscoder, DeElevator64) for DLL side-loading since the Cobalt Kitty campaign — Cybereason, ESET (KerrDown / Salgorea), and Volexity reports all enumerate them. ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / BISMUTH) Office maldoc → rundll32/regsvr32/mshta loader chain with non-PE-extension payload
ucs.description: Hunts APT32's primary delivery TTP: a macro-laden Word/Excel/PowerPoint document spawning rundll32, regsvr32, or mshta to execute a staged payload from a user-writable directory, often disguised with a non-PE extension (.dat / .png / .ocx / .tmp / .bin). This Office→LOLBin→staged DLL chain is the OceanLotus signature pivot from delivery (T1204) to execution (T1218).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime FROM datamodel=Endpoint.Processes WHERE Processes.parent_process_name IN ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe") AND (Processes.process="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Roaming\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Public\\*" OR Processes.process="*\\Downloads\\*" OR Processes.process="*.dat,*" OR Processes.process="*.tmp,*" OR Processes.process="*.png,*" OR Processes.process="*.bin,*" OR Processes.process="*.ocx,*" OR Processes.process="*.jpg,*" OR Processes.process="*scrobj.dll*") AND NOT Processes.user IN ("*$") BY Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// APT32 (OceanLotus) maldoc → LOLBin loader chain
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Roaming\", @"\Public\", @"\Downloads\")
   or ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dat|tmp|png|bin|ocx|jpg|dll),[A-Za-z@#_]"
   or ProcessCommandLine has "scrobj.dll"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend OfficeParent = InitiatingProcessFileName
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, OfficeParent, ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildBin = FileName, ChildCmd = ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// APT32 maldoc → LOLBin via ASIM ImProcessCreate
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| extend ParentBase = tostring(split(ParentProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| extend TargetBase = tostring(split(TargetProcessName, "\\")[-1])
| where ParentBase in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe")
| where TargetBase in~ ("rundll32.exe","regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Roaming\", @"\Public\", @"\Downloads\")
   or TargetProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(dat|tmp|png|bin|ocx|jpg|dll),[A-Za-z@#_]"
   or TargetProcessCommandLine has "scrobj.dll"
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Office Maldoc Spawning LOLBin Loader
id: 8d4e7b2c-1a6f-49c3-bf2e-3c5a9e1b8d04
status: experimental
description: Detects Microsoft Office applications spawning rundll32/regsvr32/mshta with a payload path under a user-writable directory or a non-PE-extension argument with an exported function — matching APT32 (OceanLotus / Canvas Cyclone / BISMUTH) multi-stage maldoc → DLL loader chains.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.microsoft.com/security/blog/2020/11/30/threat-actor-leverages-coin-miner-techniques-to-stay-under-the-radar-heres-how-to-spot-them/
author: SOC Detection Team
date: 2024/01/01
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\winword.exe'
      - '\excel.exe'
      - '\powerpnt.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_path:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\Roaming\'
      - '\Public\'
      - '\Downloads\'
      - '.dat,'
      - '.tmp,'
      - '.png,'
      - '.bin,'
      - '.ocx,'
      - '.jpg,'
      - 'scrobj.dll'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_path
falsepositives:
  - Rare legitimate Office add-ins that load custom DLLs from per-user paths via rundll32
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1137
  - attack.g0050
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\winword.exe OR *\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\Winword.exe OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\Excel.exe OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\PowerPnt.exe OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\Outlook.exe) @Image:(*\\rundll32.exe OR *\\Rundll32.exe OR *\\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\Regsvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\Mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE) @CommandLine:(*\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\Roaming\\* OR *\\Public\\* OR *\\Downloads\\* OR *.dat,* OR *.tmp,* OR *.png,* OR *.bin,* OR *.ocx,* OR *.jpg,* OR *scrobj.dll*) -@User:*$
